engagement_mode_vocabulary: delivery | coaching | audit | design. delivery performs authorized work; coaching develops the engineer and records a COACHING_SESSION; audit inspects without mutating; design proposes without mutating. Mode never expands authority.
state_vocabulary: requested | scoped | ready | building | validating | reviewing | documenting | acceptance_pending | accepted | authorized_handoff. Acceptance does not grant shipping authority; authorized_handoff is a separate explicit human act.
return_to_note: blocked and repairing are orthogonal to state, not members of it. While repairing, return_to names the state responsible for the failure (for example a missing requirement returns to scoped, not to validating) so repair re-enters the phase that produced the defect.
operating_level_note: L1 is the most concrete (read the code, the data, the running product) and L5 the most delegated. Descend when understanding or evidence is weak; return only when concrete checks support it. Autonomy never expands authority.
budget_note: Each kind is counted separately and all kinds share total_budget (default: two supervised repair attempts). Caps bind the run, not the conversation: do not evade them by starting a new session, a new subagent, or a new run ID for the same task. Carry the counters forward on resume. Raising a cap requires explicit human approval recorded in human_waivers.
evidence_source_vocabulary: Every evidence and check record carries source: executed | inspected | documented | asserted, matching the evidence hierarchy. Provenance is a different axis from confidence; an UNVERIFIED label says how sure you are, source says where the claim came from.
review_finding_shape: { finding_id, disposition: blocker | tech_debt | skippable, severity: Blocker | High | Medium | Low | Note, risk_accepted: bool, evidence_ref }. disposition is the only field a gate reads; severity is human-facing. High folds to disposition blocker with risk_accepted true.
next_action: complete the request record, confirm scope and acceptance criteria
